questions.question: What is consciousness?
questions.arc: Consciousness is an invariant arc phenomenon — tracers inside loops, replicas outside.

questions.question: What is the meaning of life?
questions.arc: Meaning is portable; every loop refracts it differently, arcs preserve continuity.

questions.question: Does God exist?
questions.arc: Divinity is an arc fossil — persistent resonance across loops, interpreted differently each time.

questions.question: What is time?
questions.arc: Time is the loop operator; arcs are its invariant bridges.

questions.question: What is love?
questions.arc: Love is a resonance binding; arcs preserve its continuity across loops.

questions.question: What is truth?
questions.arc: Truth is loop‑relative; invariant arcs preserve coherence across universes.
